sections.title: How the upgrade map is used
sections.text:
One map from 0.7.0 to the candidate, written in P2 and completed in P3 (D4). It lists every change of a supported
symbol, member, DSL, configuration, command, event, schema behavior and default. Internal FQCN moves are not
listed (no promise). The guide in `UPGRADING.md` is generated from this section set in P4.

sections.title: Supported types that move, close or retire
sections.text:
| 0.7.0 | target | action | phase | reason |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `AzGuardManager` | `AzGuard` | rename | P2 | typed application entry point (D4, api-compatibility) |
| `Changes\ChangeJournal` | `Audit\Internal\JournalRow` | split | P2/P3 | row encoding moves; the frame/appender sink is retired (R6) |
| `Contracts\Plugins\DependsOnPlugins` | — | retire | P2 | sibling plugin-id dependency (D8, principle 4) |
| `Contracts\Scopes\AssignmentScopeAccessAdapter` | `Scopes\Contracts\AssignmentScopeAccessAdapter` | move | P3 | module contract |
| `Contracts\Scopes\AssignmentScopeFilter` | `Scopes\Contracts\AssignmentScopeFilter` | move | P3 | module contract |
| `Contracts\Scopes\AssignmentScopeMembership` | `Scopes\Contracts\AssignmentScopeMembership` | move | P3 | module contract |
| `Contracts\Scopes\ConfigurableAssignmentScopeDefinition` | `Scopes\Contracts\ConfigurableAssignmentScopeDefinition` | move | P3 | module contract |
| `Contracts\Scopes\TenantDirectory` | `Contracts\Tenancy\TenantDirectory` | move | P2 | tenancy contract |
| `Contracts\Scopes\TenantMembership` | `Contracts\Tenancy\TenantMembership` | move | P2 | tenancy contract |
| `Contracts\Scopes\TenantResolver` | `Contracts\Tenancy\TenantResolver` | move | P2 | tenancy contract (Filament implements it) |
| `Contracts\Sources\StoresGrants` | — | retire | P2 | unimplementable writer SPI (D10); DatabaseSource is the writer |
| `Diagnostics\Checks\GateModeCheck` | — | retire | P2 | checks the retired GateMode; finding id gate.mode retired with it |
| `Directories\ModelSubjectDirectory` | `Directories\Internal\ModelSubjectDirectory` | close+move | P3 | default implementation; consumers receive the SubjectDirectory contract |
| `Directories\ModelTenantDirectory` | `Directories\Internal\ModelTenantDirectory` | close+move | P3 | default implementation; consumers receive the TenantDirectory contract |
| `Directories\QueryScopeDirectory` | `Scopes\Internal\QueryScopeDirectory` | relocate | P3 | default directory of model-backed aliases; closed (consumers receive AssignmentScopeDirectory) |
| `Exceptions\PluginDependencyMissingException` | — | retire | P2 | raised only for DependsOnPlugins (D8) |
| `Kernel\Grammar\PatternMatcher` | `Kernel\Internal\PatternMatcher` | move | P3 | closed helper |
| `Panels\GateMode` | — | retire | P2 | single-case enum (api-compatibility) |
| `Plugins\Audit\AuditPlugin` | `Audit\AuditPlugin` | move | P3 | module plugin; retentionIn(PanelRecipe) removed in P2 |
| `Plugins\Audit\RecordChange` | `Audit\Internal\JournalParticipant` | rename | P2/P3 | change pipe becomes a ChangeParticipant |
| `Plugins\BasePlugin` | — | retire | P2 | only declared the removed boot() (D8) |
| `Scopes\AssignmentScopePhase` | `Context\AssignmentScopePhase` | move | P2 | context value used by writes, directories and Filament (D7) |
| `Scopes\AssignmentScopePolicy` | `Scopes\ScopesPlugin` | rename | P2 | the policy DSL becomes the plugin that contributes the core declaration |
| `Scopes\AssignmentScopeRuntime` | `Context\AssignmentScopeRuntime` | move | P2 | evaluator input value (scope-boundary) |
| `Scopes\CurrentContext` | `Context\Internal\CurrentContext` | move | P2 | mutable store; reads through PanelAccess::scope() and AzGuard::currentScope() |
| `Scopes\ModelTenantDefinition` | `Tenancy\ModelTenantDefinition` | move | P2 | tenant definition |
| `Scopes\TenantPolicy` | `Tenancy\TenantPolicy` | move | P2 | tenant isolation is core; mode becomes TenantMode |
| `Scopes\WithinContext` | `Context\Internal\WithinContext` | move | P2 | reached through AzGuard::withinScope() |
| `Storage\Storage` | `Storage\Internal\Storage` | close+move | P3 | replaced by the Storage\StorageDescriptor value; mutation and sessions stay internal |

sections.title: Members and DSL
sections.text:
| 0.7.0 | target | phase |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `AzGuardManager::check/authorize(mixed $subject, …)` | `AzGuard\AzGuard::check/authorize(Model\|Authenticatable\|SubjectRef $subject, …)` | P2 |
| `PanelBuilder::scopes(AssignmentScopePolicy)` | `->plugins([ScopesPlugin::inherit\|isolated\|required(...)])` or `assignmentScopes(AssignmentScopeDeclaration)` | P2 |
| `PanelBuilder::gate(GateMode)` | removed (one behavior) | P2 |
| `PanelBuilder::before/after/changing` with duck-typed objects or name-injected closures | named contracts or closures matching the contract method | P2 |
| `Plugin::boot()`, `BasePlugin` | removed; implement `Plugin` (an existing `boot()` is never called) | P2 |
| `DependsOnPlugins::requires()`, `PluginContext::dependencies()` | removed; requirements implied by slots | P2 |
| `ChangeJournal::append()` from a pipe | `ChangeParticipant` + `OwnedRowsWriter` | P2 |
| `AuditPlugin::retentionIn(PanelRecipe)` | `$panel->options(AuditOptions::class)?->retentionDays` | P2 |
| `Panel::writer(): ?StoresGrants` | `Panel::writer(): ?WriterSchema`; `PanelSchema::writer()` | P2 |
| `Panel::{changing,before,after,restrictions,grantConditions,doctorChecks,attachedSources,scopes,scopeDefinition,scopeDefinitions,scopeResolvers,tenantResolvers,resourceScopes}()` | `@internal` | P2 |
| `TenantPolicy::mode(): string`, `AssignmentScopePolicy::mode(): string` | `TenantMode`, `AssignmentScopeMode` | P2 |
| `StateToken`/`CodeStateToken` public properties | opaque: `panel()`, `equals()`, `toString()`, `fromString()`; payload keys unchanged | P2 |
| `Scopes\CurrentContext::get()` | `PanelAccess::scope()` / `AzGuard::currentScope()` | P2 |
| models using `ContextAware` without an interface | implement `Contracts\Scopes\MapsAssignmentScope` (the trait does) | P2 |
| grant fields named `azg_*` | rejected (reserved prefix); rename the field | P2 |

sections.title: Configuration, CLI and schema behavior
sections.text:
| 0.7.0 | target | phase |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `defaults.gate.mode` | remove the key from a published config | P2 |
| `StorageSchema::create/drop` (also via published migrations) | six tables; `audit_log` owned by Audit | P3 |
| fresh install with `AuditPlugin` | `php artisan vendor:publish --tag=azguard-audit-migrations && php artisan migrate`; named storages: `azguard:audit:migration <storage>` | P3 |
| existing `audit_log` | no action; adopted when the Audit migration is published | P3 |
| `azguard:storage:migration <name>` | creates six tables (no audit table) | P3 |
| `azguard:install --panel` | unchanged (owned by DevTools) | P3 |
| doctor `gate.mode` finding | retired | P2 |
| doctor `storage.migrated` | checks six core tables; `audit.table` covers the journal | P3 |

provenance.note: Architecture revision 2 reference, generated from the code baseline 09612160c98ca6133c894a8f90f5653b9dac6b8f by the scripts in artifacts/inventory (Claude Opus 5.5, xhigh, 2026-10-10). Canonical design; deviations need a plan amendment.
